about.headline: Your Gateway to the UAE FMCG Market
about.lead: Zenhouz International is a UAE-based FMCG trading and distribution company connecting international manufacturers and brands with UAE retail, modern trade, organized trade and B2B markets.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.desc: We are a dedicated commercial trading house established in the United Arab Emirates, bridging the gap between world-class FMCG manufacturers and the dynamic retail ecosystem of the Gulf region.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.desc: We manage end-to-end commercial operations: identifying high-potential consumer products, navigating UAE regulatory compliance, managing port-of-entry imports, and executing distribution across retail and wholesale channels.

ourApproach.title: Our Approach
ourApproach.desc: Disciplined, transparent, and partner-centric. We view our suppliers as long-term brand principals, focusing on sustained market placement rather than short-term spot trading.

whyPartner.title: Why Partner With Us
whyPartner.desc: Our direct access to modern trade buyers, agile warehousing logistics in the UAE, and unwavering commitment to brand integrity make Zenhouz the ideal partner for market entry and scaling.

uaeAdvantage.title: The Strategic UAE Hub
uaeAdvantage.desc: With world-class maritime ports, advanced logistics corridors, and a thriving consumer demographic, the UAE serves as the premier launchpad for Middle Eastern commerce.
